evidence.summary: T10 requires complete source-to-score lineage and records the known W28 gap.

reproduction: On fresh main, confirm T10 remains ACTIVE with W28 lineage gap and no single deterministic current report enumerates all forward official forecast chains and exact missing edges from frozen source through score.
